paragraphs.source_en: A faint light went out on the second floor of the house, which was fairly visible from the street. Perhaps Count and Countess Ayakura had gone to sleep. The Count had always gone to bed early. Maybe Satoko was still lying awake. But her light could not be seen. He walked along the wall until he came to the rear gate. There, without thinking, he stretched out his hand to push the cracked and yellowed doorbell, but then drew back.

paragraphs.source_en: Stricken with shame at his cowardice, he turned and went home.

units.source_en: Stricken with shame at his cowardice, he turned and went home.

paragraphs.source_en: More days passed, a terrible period of dead calm. Then still more days. He went to school, but only as a means of somehow getting through each day. When he came home, he gave no thought to his studies.

ja.t: ごすためにすぎなかった。

units.source_en: When he came home, he gave no thought to his studies.

paragraphs.source_en: All around him at school were constant reminders that many of his classmates, Honda among them, were totally absorbed in preparations for the next spring’s university entrance examination. It was no more difficult to recognize the behavior of those who were planning to take the easier route of entering schools that did not have entrance requirements. These students were zealously pursuing their favorite sports. Since he had nothing in common with either camp, Kiyoaki became more and more lonely. If someone spoke to him, he often did not answer, and so his classmates began to be rather unfriendly.

paragraphs.source_en: One day when he returned from school, he found Yamada the steward waiting for him at the entranceway.

units.source_en: One day when he returned from school, he found Yamada the steward waiting for him at the entranceway.

paragraphs.source_en: “His Excellency came home early today, and he expressed a desire to play billiards with the young master. He now awaits him in the billiard room,” Yamada announced.

units.source_en: “His Excellency came home early today, and he expressed a desire to play billiards with the young master.

ja.t: とビリヤードをなさりたいとのことです。

units.source_en: He now awaits him in the billiard room,” Yamada announced.

paragraphs.source_en: Kiyoaki felt his heart beat faster as he heard this altogether extraordinary summons. True, the Marquis did sometimes feel the whim to have Kiyoaki’s partnership in a game of billiards, but this was customarily restricted to the mellow period after dinner when the Marquis still savored the effects of the wine he had been drinking.

paragraphs.source_en: If his father were seized by such a mood while it was still no more than mid-afternoon, he must, Kiyoaki thought, be either in exceptionally good or exceptionally bad spirits.

paragraphs.source_en: He hardly ever entered the billiard room during the day. He pushed open the heavy door and walked in. The sun was shining in through the west windows, its rays slightly distorted by the glass. When he saw how the oak paneling gleamed in the sunlight, he had the feeling that he had entered this room for the first time.
